audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was scored Lillia in both layers while the content why says neither champion threatens; the 2+ items row was 'Skill' while every prose field says Sejuani owns the late game outright.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill at level 1 and Sejuani at 2+ items, the mirror audit agrees the late game is hers, and whys[6]/spikes[3]/late all say the same. The chart contradicted the page's own text.
audit.corrected: Row 0 to Skill (5/10) and row 6 to Sejuani (3/10), proposed as matched full+content pairs with the whys rewritten to match.

audit.why: Levels 4-5 as Lillia's peak and the first-item burn spike are right; her spike is tank stats plus the Frost-stack CC chain, which the 2+ items row now reflects.
audit.corrected: phases[6].why restated to name the actual late-game mechanism instead of describing Lillia dominating a stage she loses.

audit.whatIsWrong: Sejuani's ability letters were scrambled throughout the content layer: Arctic Assault was called her E, Permafrost was called her W, and 'W percent-HP shred' was asserted. Riot's text gives Sejuani no percent-health damage at all.
audit.why: Arctic Assault is Q (650 range, 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s), Winter's Wrath is W (applies the Frost stacks), Permafrost is E (560 range, 1.5s cooldown, stuns only at max Frost). The real chain is W to stack Frost, then E to stun — and Frost Armor grants immunity to slows, which is what actually blanks Swirlseed. None of that reached the page.
audit.corrected: Every letter fixed, the W-into-E Frost chain stated, the fabricated percent-HP shred removed, Frost Armor's slow immunity and the bonus damage on a stunned target added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Arctic Assault was called 'the clock this lane runs on' with no number.
audit.why: 18s at rank 1 down to 12s at rank 5 is a huge window — it is the difference between a vague warning and a usable green light.
audit.corrected: Cooldown added to dosFull[2].d and early.

edits.before: Q's outer ring on his last-hits plus the passive speed means he literally cannot touch you at level 1.
edits.after: Neither of you threatens at 1 — she has no burst, you have one ability, so farm at Q sweetspot range.

edits.before: You're a teamfight nightmare now: sleep two, kite the rest, and let the burn do the bookkeeping.
edits.after: Full-tank Sejuani chains Permafrost stun into Glacial Prison through your hops — never duel her here.

edits.before: Sejuani spends Arctic Assault early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Arctic Assault is 18s at rank 1 — once she spends it, the next 15 seconds are yours.

edits.before: Full kite chain online — the E (Swirlseed) slow and stacking move speed keep you outside her E (Arctic Assault) while the burn ticks her down.
edits.after: Full kite chain online — the E (Swirlseed) slow and stacking move speed keep you outside her Q (Arctic Assault) while the burn ticks her down.

edits.before: She out-scales you outright — W percent-HP shred melts you while Permafrost, E stun and R (Glacial Prison) lock you out of every kite, so never duel her late.
edits.after: She out-scales you outright — Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost, Permafrost (E) then stuns on a 1.5s cooldown and Glacial Prison follows, so never duel her late.

edits.before: Her R (Glacial Prison) and E (Arctic Assault) stun lock you mid-kite, and W percent-HP shreds you while Permafrost slows kill your move-speed advantage.
edits.after: Her R (Glacial Prison) and Arctic Assault (Q) knockup lock you mid-kite, and Winter's Wrath stacks Frost so Permafrost (E) stuns you out of every hop.

edits.before: Sejuani brings zero early burst — her kit is percent-HP and CC, not a kill threat — so the level 1-3 window is yours to chip. At 1 you only have Q (Blooming Blows), so just farm from range with the sweetspot; by 2-3 you layer the E (Swirlseed) slow and start the Dream Dust burn, and your stacking move speed keeps you outside her E (Arctic Assault) gap-close. The one thing to fear is her Permafrost: do not let her auto-stack you to the frost proc, because that slow is the only way an immobile tank touches you, and a single E stun on your squishy body undoes the whole kite.
edits.after: Sejuani brings zero early burst — her kit is Frost stacks and CC, not a kill threat — so the level 1-3 window is yours to chip. At 1 you only have Q (Blooming Blows), so farm from range with the sweetspot; by 2-3 you layer the E (Swirlseed) slow and start the Dream Dust burn, and your move speed keeps you outside her Q (Arctic Assault) gap-close, an 18s cooldown at rank 1. The chain to fear is Winter's Wrath (W) stacking Frost until Permafrost (E) stuns you on a 1.5s cooldown, and Frost Armor makes her immune to slows, so Swirlseed does nothing until you have broken it.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your best window — full Q rank, max move-speed stacks, and the Dream Dust DoT compounding mean you grind her down every time she has to step up and farm, and she simply can't catch you to trade back. Bait her E (Arctic Assault) dash out, then hop away and let the burn tick. Level 6 is real but situational: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps her after she's eaten Dream Dust, and the delay plus her Frost Armor make it a jungle-assisted setup, not a solo execute on a tank. Never burn it expecting a 1v1 kill.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your best window — full Q rank, max move-speed stacks, and the Dream Dust DoT compounding mean you grind her down every time she has to step up and farm, and she simply can't catch you to trade back. Bait her Q (Arctic Assault) dash — 18s at rank 1 — then hop away and let the burn tick. Level 6 is real but situational: Lilting Lullaby only sleeps her after she's eaten Dream Dust, and the delay plus her Frost Armor make it a jungle-assisted setup, not a solo execute on a tank. Never burn it expecting a 1v1 kill.

edits.before: This is where Sejuani flips the lane. She builds full tank with W (Permafrost) percent-HP shred that chunks you through your squishy frame, and her CC suite is exactly what kills a kiter — Permafrost slows neuter your move-speed lead, E (Arctic Assault) stuns you mid-hop, and R (Glacial Prison) flies across a fight to lock you out of your own combo. You cannot duel her once she has two items. Convert your 4-to-first-item burn lead into roams and tower pressure, then play around her engage in fights rather than ever standing still next to her.
edits.after: This is where Sejuani flips the lane. She builds full tank and her CC suite is exactly what kills a kiter — Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost on you, Permafrost (E) then stuns on a 1.5s cooldown, Arctic Assault (Q) knocks you up mid-hop, and R (Glacial Prison) flies across a fight to lock you out of your own combo. Frost Armor makes her immune to your Swirlseed slow, and she gets bonus magic damage for hitting a stunned target. You cannot duel her once she has two items. Convert your burn lead into roams and tower pressure, and never stand still next to her.

edits.after: Stack Q sweetspots and Dream Dust burn while your move speed keeps you out of her Q (Arctic Assault) range

notes: The content layer had Sejuani's ability letters scrambled (Arctic Assault filed as E, Permafrost as W) and asserted a percent-health shred she does not have in Riot's text — that was the biggest error here. Frost Armor's slow immunity is the interaction that most changes how you play the lane and it was absent entirely. Mirror (sejuani__lillia) agrees late game is hers; ratings kept inverse.
